name: nxbridge
description: Claude Code 与 Codex CLI 的本地平等搭档通信

scripts.build: node tools/sync-version.mjs && node tools/mod-revision.mjs && node tools/identity-revision.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:publish && node tools/run-tests.mjs --test --test-timeout=30000 "dist/tests/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test:native: npm run build && npm run build:publish && node tools/run-tests.mjs --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=180000 "dist/native-tests/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test:native:target: npm run build && npm run build:publish && node tools/test-native-version.mjs 0.166.0
scripts.check: node tools/sync-version.mjs --check && node tools/mod-revision.mjs --check && node tools/identity-revision.mjs --check && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
